summary: Visual and layout regression pass after the typography overhaul. FRONTEND ONLY, Expo web preview. Viewports: 390x844, 375x667, 320x568 and 768x1024. Each screen got an automated DOM audit (/tmp/audit.js copied to screenshots_iter69/audit.js) that flags text overflowing horizontally, text clipped vertically, text clipped by its parent, offscreen text and offscreen buttons, plus screenshots. At 390 most screens hold up: no horizontal page scroll, prices are the strongest element, no console errors. Real breaks: (1) the global Button component and the passport Unlock CTA have content that cannot shrink, so long labels spill out on both sides and cut off the icon and the text; (2) short screens (375x667, 320x568) clip the onboarding headline and subtitle; (3) at 320 the large titles break mid-word ('Upda/tes', 'neighbo/urs'); (4) the Neighbours friends row is a plain flex row, not a scroll view, so friends 4+ and the 'Add' button are cut off and cannot be reached at every width; (5) a Market retailer badge overflows its card; at 320 the Market basket button is pushed off-screen and shop prices are truncated ('₦12,389,0…'). Tablet 768 is clean. Login, register, compose, chat input, tab bar (390 and 320), wallet, product page and post detail are clean. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: The CTA content overflows the gradient pill. At 390: the coin icon is cut in half on the left and 'confirm before paying' becomes 'confirm before payin' (8px over). At 375: 15px over. At 320: 43px over, showing 'nlock for 1,200 MASS' and 'u have 12,642 MASS · confirm before', with the icon hidden. RCA: app/property/[id].tsx:743, the inner <View> has no flexShrink:1 and the two AppTexts have no numberOfLines, while the pill centres its content. Fix: <View style={{flexShrink:1}}> plus numberOfLines={1} (adjustsFontSizeToFit is optional) on both lines, or shorten the subtitle to 'Balance 12,642 MASS'. Screenshots: 39_pp390_cta, 40_pp320.

numberOfLines={1} on the label has no effect because neither the row View (line 135) nor the AppText (line 137) can shrink. Long labels spill out of the pill on both sides and clip the left icon. Seen on /become-agent: 'My representations' and 'Plans & upgrade' side by side, 8px over at 390 and 26px/13px over at 320 (29_reps). Seen on home tiles at 320: 'Unlock · 1,200 MASS' 9px over. Fix: add maxWidth:'100%' and flexShrink:1 to styles.row and flexShrink:1 to the label AppText so the ellipsis can engage. This fixes every Button in the app.

On short screens the text area under the hero is too short. At 375x667 the 2nd subtitle line is cut in half ('one map', 'nearby'), see 33_onb375_*. At 320x568 the 38px serif heading itself is cut through the middle ('find your home', 'buy. sell.', 'fix anything', 'one simple') and the subtitle is invisible, see 32_onb320_*. RCA: app/onboarding.tsx:170 heroH = max(340, height*0.56) leaves too little room. Fix: scale heroH for height<700 (e.g. height*0.46, min ~240) and/or step the heading down to 32px with adjustsFontSizeToFit. At 390x844 it is fine.

The connections preview is a plain <View style={{flexDirection:'row'}}> (app/(tabs)/neighbours.tsx:215). With 8 previews plus Add the row is 656px wide inside a 326px container that has overflow hidden. Avatars after the 3rd–4th and the 'Add' (find friends) button are cut off and cannot be reached at 320, 375 and 390. Fix: wrap the row in a horizontal ScrollView or limit the preview to about 4 items plus '+N'. Screenshot: 21_friends.

At 320 the 26px 'Updates' h2 has only 76px next to the emblem and three 44px icon buttons, so it breaks mid-word into 'Upda/tes'. The subtitle '2 unread …' is also truncated (36_upd320). The Neighbours 38px serif title breaks into 'neighbo/urs' (42_nb320). Both are fine at 375 and 390. Fix: numberOfLines={1} plus adjustsFontSizeToFit/minimumFontScale, or a responsive size below 360 width.

At 320 the header row overflows: the heart button is partly cut off and shop-basket-btn (with badge) sits at x=327–363, fully off-screen. location-selector shows 'All of Nige…' at every width (78px, also at 390). The search placeholder wraps to 2 lines at 320. Screenshot: 41_mk320. Fix: let the location pill shrink, or reduce the 'Market' title size or icon count when width<360.

The tag badge 'Manufacturer warranty honoured (varies by brand)' runs past the card and the viewport (right edge 417px at 390 width). RCA: src/components/shop/RetailerCards.tsx:70–71, Badge has no maxWidth or numberOfLines. Fix: Badge maxWidth:'100%' plus numberOfLines={1}, or shorten the tag labels.

At 320 the 23px price is truncated ('₦12,389,0…', '₦11,389,0…'), which breaks the 'no truncated numbers' rule (43_cat320). 'Stock: confirm with store' overflows the card (right edge 323px). At 390 the 'From' label sits above the price in one card and inline in the other, so the two grid columns are misaligned (16_category). Fix: adjustsFontSizeToFit with minimumFontScale 0.75 on the price (or a compact ₦12.4M format below 360), and numberOfLines={1} on the stock line.

The 18px placeholder 'Search area, estate or landmark' is hard-clipped without an ellipsis: 'Search area, estate or la' at 390 and 'Search area, es' at 320. Fix: shorter placeholder ('Search area or estate') or 16–17px placeholder text.
At 320 the 24px title shows '3 homes …' and the subtitle '2 for sale · 1 to re…' because 'Explore wider' takes the remaining width (35_home320).

At 320 the '8 verified' pill is cut off at the card edge; the pill row does not wrap (45_ad320). '₦1.2B' at 48px has lineHeight 52px against a 59px glyph box (scrollHeight 59 > 52), which risks clipping the top or bottom on Android. Use lineHeight ≥ 58 and flexWrap on the pill row.
12px uppercase labels truncate: 'SCHOOLS' at 390 (60px tile), 'SCHOOLS' and 'SAFETY' at 320 (42px). Reduce letterSpacing or allow 2 lines.
At 320 the stat value '2026' (26px) and the label 'Unlocked' are truncated in 60px tiles (44_prof320).
At 390 'Yes, I'm the owner' wraps to 2 lines and 'No, I'm an agent' touches the pill edge (28_agent_onb). Reduce horizontal padding or font size, or stack the pills.

The step chips 'Join your estate', 'Share an item' and 'Like a post' wrap to 2 lines inside small pills, which looks cramped (11c_nearby). In Nearby mode the header subtitle 'Free & for-sale items from n…' is also truncated.
The placeholder 'Search messages, agents…' is clipped by the 'Verified' filter button at 390 (30_inbox).
The location chips on the floating photo tiles are hidden behind the AMASS logo card ('Lekk', 'V.I. L…') at 320, 375 and 390.

issues: No issues: labels fit at 390 (12.5px) and 320 (11px compact), no truncation, and the Updates/Neighbours badges are visible.
The home 'Satellite imagery renders on mobile' hint and the lowest map pin (₦14M) sit underneath the floating tab bar. This is web-preview only.

action_items: HIGH: src/ui/Button.tsx: add flexShrink:1 and maxWidth:'100%' to the content row (line 135) and flexShrink:1 to the label AppText (line 137) so numberOfLines ellipsis works. Fixes my-reps-btn/see-plans-btn on /become-agent and home-tile-primary at 320.
HIGH: app/property/[id].tsx:743–749: unlock-cta-btn inner View needs flexShrink:1 and both texts numberOfLines={1}. The icon and text are clipped at 390, 375 and 320.
HIGH: app/onboarding.tsx:170: make heroH responsive for short screens (height<700), and/or reduce the heading size on small screens. The heading and subtitle are clipped at 375x667 and 320x568.
HIGH: app/(tabs)/neighbours.tsx:215: the friends preview row must scroll horizontally (or be capped at ~4 plus '+N'). The 'Add' friend button cannot be reached at any width.
MEDIUM: Updates and Neighbours tab titles: add numberOfLines={1} plus adjustsFontSizeToFit (or smaller size below 360px) to stop the 'Upda/tes' and 'neighbo/urs' mid-word breaks at 320.
MEDIUM: Market header at 320: shop-basket-btn is off-screen. Let location-selector shrink or reduce header items.
MEDIUM: src/components/shop/RetailerCards.tsx:71: Badge needs maxWidth/numberOfLines. The Pointek warranty tag overflows the card.

MEDIUM: Shop product card: stop the price truncating at 320 (adjustsFontSizeToFit or compact format), keep the 'From' label placement consistent across columns, and add numberOfLines on the stock line.

LOW: Shorten or resize the placeholders on home-search-input and the inbox search; portfolio-hero pills need flexWrap and a larger lineHeight on ₦1.2B; fix the neighborhood-scores label truncation; profile stats at 320; owner/agent pills on agent onboarding.
critical_code_review_comments: The shared Button pattern (centred row, numberOfLines on text, but no shrink) is the root cause behind several overflows. Fixing it once in src/ui/Button.tsx is the most effective change.

Several big headings (h1/h2 at 26–38px) sit in flex rows next to fixed 44px icon buttons and have no numberOfLines or adjustsFontSizeToFit, so they break mid-word on narrow devices. Consider a small-screen scale (width<360) in AppText or the tokens.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) in package.json. No SafeAreaView imported from react-native.

success_rate.frontend: ~75% of audited screens clean at 390px; 4 HIGH layout breaks; more breaks at 320px

seed_data_creation: None. No forms submitted, no MASS spent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter69/audit.js + helpers.py. In a browser_automation script: ns={'page':page}; exec(open('/tmp/helpers.py').read(), ns), then use ns['login'](w,h), ns['visit'](path,name), ns['audit'](name). Copy the files to /tmp first. Screenshots only show up when page.screenshot is called directly in the script with a .jpg path. Login via the UI each run (localStorage key amass_auth_token). Re-verify at 320x568 and 375x667, not just 390.
rca_of_issue: Most breaks come from containers that cannot shrink (no flexShrink or maxWidth) combined with the larger type, plus fixed-size layouts that leave too little room on short or narrow screens (the onboarding heroH floor of 340px, header rows with three 44px icon buttons). Reproduce by opening the listed routes at 320x568 or 375x667.
